We have two released orders on that cell — Order K with 320 aluminum brackets and Order L with 180 stainless enclosures. Since changing material families creates setup loss, the normal preference is to run one material family completely before switching. Before I sign the final production plan, I need to take our standard three reports: quality, maintenance, and logistics. Let's start with any known constraints. Quality, what do you have for me?
